articleTitle: Disc Replacement vs. Microdiscectomy: What It Means When Your Surgeon Skips the Smaller Surgery
imageHeadline: Your surgeon skipped microdiscectomy. Here's why.
imageSubtext: What it means when disc replacement is the first recommendation
pinTitle: Disc Replacement vs. Microdiscectomy: When Your Surgeon Recommends the Bigger Surgery
pinDescription: When a spine surgeon says microdiscectomy won't work and recommends disc replacement instead, it's usually about what imaging shows—severe degeneration, instability, or high re-herniation risk. Understand what that recommendation means, what questions to ask about your specific case, and how to decide if the bigger procedure is right for you.

items.label: Understand why the smaller surgery won't work
Ask about your surgeon's experience with this procedure
Clarify what recovery actually looks like
Consider whether a second opinion makes sense
